lines.1: It had been about a week since student council activities began.
lines.2: My once-ordinary days had become hectic.
lines.3: ...I still couldn't stop thinking about her.
lines.6: A beautiful half-Japanese, half-American girl--arrogant, haughty, and supremely self-centered.
lines.7: --And that was precisely what made her beautiful.
lines.8: She had the ability and looks to justify her confidence.
lines.9: Honestly, I even respected the strength of her spirit.
lines.10: Sometimes she ordered me around with a flick of her chin, but even that wasn't so bad. That's what happens when you're smitten.
lines.11: I'd joined the student council, after all.
lines.12: I hoped I could grow closer to the Princess I admired.
lines.14: 「...All right. Today's self-training quota is done.」
lines.15: Now all I needed was a bath to loosen my body and a good night's sleep. Perfect.
lines.17: In other words, another step toward my ambition.
lines.23: Hmm. One of the maids answering to my relatives.
lines.24: She was reporting my every move.
lines.25: I'd been letting her carry on, but she was becoming increasingly irritating.
lines.26: Perhaps it was time to ask her to leave the stage.
lines.27: Still, having to stay alert even inside my own home... I could never let down my guard.
lines.28: This world was full of pretense and betrayal.
lines.29: And I sincerely believed that was what made it interesting.
lines.30: I spun the globe around and around.
lines.33: I had been born human, blessed with limitless potential.
lines.34: I wanted to discover just how high I could climb--
lines.35: to someday control the world as easily as I spun the globe in my hands.
lines.36: That was my pure and honest wish.
lines.37: Others might laugh and call it a childish dream, but I had already begun running toward that goal.
lines.39: The moment I saw who was calling, my face softened on its own.
lines.41: 「Mm. I thought we could walk to school together tomorrow.」
lines.47: 「I have more I want to talk about, but it's already late. Good night, Ellie.」
lines.48: 「Mm. See you tomorrow. Good night, Yoppi.」
